title: 向日葵田
scene: ONE large joyful sunflower with EIGHT broad rounded petals, a huge smiling center, and TWO wide wavy leaves dances sideways playfully. Stem is ONE confident solid black curved line, NOT a narrow enclosed white tube. No seeds or checker texture in the center; simple solid-black dot eyes and a single OPEN smile curve. No flowerpot, horizon, other flowers, butterflies, stars, clouds or grass; empty white backdrop. All petals thick and broad, no narrow double outline at the center or leaves. Aim for 12–14 big closed colorable shapes.
